data.raw_text:
Right now there's a lot going on in my country. Typhoons, Corruption,  Pseudo resiliency and more. 

It's been storming for a while, though the affected area for the most part right now is called Cebu. Please consider looking into it as well, it's a beautiful place... However, the flood struck and right now a lot of people are stranded, starving, and even dying. So far there's over 110 people who have died. Even the supposed aid at an area received is a one meal- PER set FAMILY- is made of 1 boiled egg, 1 hotdog cut in half, and rice– Meaning if you were lucky enough to have all been on the roof and survived the two story high flood with your family (averaging to 4 at minimum), all of you would have to ration it. Please support these people and even those adovcating for the proper place of donation. 

For a shitty short amount of context; The government is under fire for pocketing billions, even trillions, amount of money from the taxing they've done with the citizens. Most are enraged from the projects that were supposed to minimise these threats of flooding through buildings, preventions, aids, and just general expenses to help recuperate damages. They've been called ghost flood projects as it has made no mark on any ground at all. 

I don't like going over these topics in public as it just stresses me out and pisses me off. I love The Philippines, I really do, but it has also become a breeding ground for tolerance under the guise of resiliency and it's deeply rooted, mostly stemming from older generations and narrow-minded people. These are even more enabled by minorities, the impoverished, through band-aid solutions and "Ayuda" or aid through cash or resources, desperation and feeling of helplessness; that this is all they have and it's all they can rely on therefore it's what they'll continue to do. Bribery has never been a discreet act and has always been a tool for the corruption to be the way it is now. Even during the voting for the political seat, it wasn't even a secret for people to receive 500php (~10usd) per vote or kilos of rice or whatever they can "barter"

I'm sorry for the sudden post and tonality of this, it's really not my alley as it really just gets me riled up and pissed off. This shit really sucks, fuck the government and its corruption and lack of urgency or sincerity to actually be of service to the people.

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 10 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Tropical Cyclone UWAN
Issued at: 8:00 AM, 10 November 2025(Monday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Zambales.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Tarlac, Pampanga, Bataan, Bulacan, Nueva Ecija, Rizal, Metro Manila, Cavite, Laguna, Batangas and Quezon(Candelaria, Dolores, San Antonio, Sariaya, Tiaong, General Nakar, Tayabas, Infanta, Lucban, Lucena, Mauban, Pagbilao, Real, Sampaloc, Panukulan, Polillo, Burdeos).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, light to moderate rains affecting Quezon(Agdangan, Alabat, Atimonan, Buenavista, Calauag, Catanauan, General Luna, Guinayangan, Gumaca, Jomalig, Lopez, Macalelon, Mulanay, Padre Burgos, Patnanungan, Perez, Pitogo, Plaridel, Quezon, San Andres, San Francisco, San Narciso, Tagkawayan, Unisan) which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 AM today.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
